exposure: Baseline hemodynamic characteristics (cardiac output, cardiac index, stroke volume, stroke volume index, systemic vascular resistance)
Lower CO and CI before fetal extraction
Vasopressor choice guided by heart rate
outcome: Post-LRA changes (blood pressure, heart rate, SV, SVR)
cohort: The study participants were women undergoing elective cesarean section with locoregional anesthesia.
finding: Lower baseline stroke volume index predicted greater vasopressor need, and lower cardiac output and cardiac index before fetal extraction correlated with reduced neonatal pH.
